name: 79110 · Amarillo, TX
findings: ZIP 79110 (Amarillo) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79110 (Amarillo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79110 (Amarillo) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 7% of all organizations here have no identified type.
